issue_context.title: Incorporate Microsoft.Identity.Web templates into our project templates
issue_context.body: We want to use the templates at https://github.com/AzureAD/microsoft-identity-web/tree/master/ProjectTemplates/templates to replace our organization auth logic.
comments: FYI for future reference the work was done completed via two PRs: https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/24167 and https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/24268
